Three of C4B's seven source_access_accounting slots can be neither populated nor bound to a frozen expectation, and a fourth mandatory O1-C07 account has no slot at all. R9 remains the sole warrant-instrument technical blocker. This candidate precisely delimits R9 rather than closing it.

dispositions_not_taken.why_not: That disposition would assert the accounting binding is complete and ready. It is not. Four mandatory accounts remain unbound and three C4B slots are unbindable. Asserting readiness would misrepresent the candidate's completeness.

The governing evidence is internally consistent. Artifact 07, the C4B template, Omega-1 and the freeze candidate agree with each other. The defect is silence on four accounts, not contradiction between two artifacts. No two governing artifacts make incompatible claims about any access-layer count.
